# OversizedContent

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

What happens to content that cannot split across pages and is taller than a page.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Clip`: Draw it at the top of a page, cut off at the bottom of the body, and record an error diagnostic (the default).
- `Throw`: Stop generation with an [`OversizedContentError`](oversized-content-error.md).
